claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a blue toy piano/keyboard shaped like a steering wheel with the Bluey brand badge.

claims.claim: All blue songs and other songs preloaded
claims.evidence: No audio or video evidence; photos only show static buttons and keys, no way to confirm preloaded content.

claims.claim: Teaching elementary Do re mi (educational function)
claims.evidence: No demonstration of sound, lights, or teaching mode in either photo.

risks.risk: Toy may not power on or produce sound/lights at all

risks.risk: Battery compartment contents and required battery type unknown
risks.proof: A clear photo of the open battery compartment showing batteries present or the required size printed inside.

risks.risk: Hidden wear, scratches, or sticker peeling on keys not visible from current angle
risks.proof: Close-up photos of each key and the top surface under good lighting.
risks.if_unproven: priced as visibly used with moderate wear

risks.proof: A photo showing the full item with any manuals, box, or extra parts if claimed to be included.

risks.risk: General hygiene/cleanliness for a children's item
risks.proof: A clean, well-lit photo of the full toy surface including underside.

proof_requests: Video of the toy powering on and playing at least one preloaded song with sound audible
Photo of the open battery compartment showing battery presence/type
Close-up photos of each key and the handle for wear/scratches
Photo of any included accessories, box, or manual if claimed
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a Bluey-branded toy piano, but all functional and completeness claims are unverifiable from photos alone, so it must be priced at worst case (possibly non-working, no batteries, no extras) pending proof.
